description: RNG fixtures for reproducible audit runs. 'launch*' fields emulate GameLaunchContext world settings (Packages/com.kruty1918.save-system/Runtime/SavePlayModeOptions.cs). 'expected*' fields are static precomputations of the production resolvers so a run can assert them before comparing live output.

resolutionRules.seed: MapSeedService.Resolve: GameLaunchContext.TryGetSeed (HasWorldSettings && seed != 0) -> GlobalSeed.Normalize; else recipe.Seed != 0 -> GlobalSeed.Normalize; else GlobalSeed.DefaultSeed (42). MapGenerationPipeline.Generate then calls GlobalSeed.InitializeDeterministic(resolved) which also UnityEngine.Random.InitState(resolved).
resolutionRules.dimensions: MapSizeResolver.Resolve: GameLaunchContext.TryGetWorldDimensions (explicit Width/Height else Size->32/64/128) -> recipe.SharedSettings when HasMapSize -> requested; then MapChunkSizePolicy.CropAxis: <16 -> 16, else floor to multiple of 16. SeedOverride requests bypass the resolver and use requested dims directly.
resolutionRules.archetype: No production MapType->archetype consumer at this base SHA (WorldArchetypeResolver is exercised only by WorldGeographyEngineTests). Expected resolvedArchetype is 'not-resolved'; world shape is determined by the loaded recipe.
resolutionRules.defaultRecipe: Assets/Moyva/Presets/Generator/recipes/testgeneratorrecipe.json (id 'testgeneratorrecipe', seed 777, SharedSettings has no map size).

seeds.purpose: Canonical default run: launch-seed precedence path, medium map.
Second distinct live seed; smallest preset to shorten generation/capture time.
Exercises MapSeedService recipe-seed fallback (launchSeed 0 -> recipe.Seed 777) and proves 'random' MapType changes nothing at this SHA.
